Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: an existing hand-painted 3:2 story postcard for the Sichuan countryside game 旅行癞疙宝.
Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Keep this exact tea courtyard picture and framing. Make a narrowly targeted edit ONLY to the small toad at lower left and its indigo floral satchel.
Primary request: enlarge that same toad by 30% relative to THIS reference (width and height each multiplied by 1.30, NOT double-sized). Move the toad AND its proportionally scaled bag down and a little right into the clear foreground paving, making the character easier to spot. Preserve its original pose and gaze toward the human ear-cleaning scene.
Placement guide for the unchanged 1536x1024 canvas: original toad body is approximately x294–406, y660–761. Target toad body approximately x439–585, y726–858, about 146px wide and 132px high. Bag rests immediately to its left, approximately x326–439, y784–860. Keep the whole character, feet, bag and red chili charm visible, not hidden by foreground leaves or furniture, not touching the image edge. Keep the feet and bag grounded with small natural contact shadows. Seamlessly restore paving where the old toad and bag were; there must remain exactly ONE toad and ONE bag.
Identity: the SAME broad squat no-neck olive toad, amber half-lidded eyes, orange bean-shaped glands, cream belly, rounded short limbs and few larger warts; the SAME indigo white-flower bag, brass clasp and red chili knot. Match the source's warm hand-painted watercolor/gouache, brown lines, clean broad shading and restrained texture.
STRICT invariants: keep both human men, their sizes, faces, hands, the ear-cleaning action, bamboo chairs, tea and tools, all tables, foliage, umbrellas, walls, original light, colors and background composition unchanged. The toad is ONLY WATCHING somebody else receive ear cleaning; never put it in the chair or give it an ear-cleaning treatment. Do not zoom or crop or move the camera. Do not make it a giant human-sized toad. Do not add objects, captions, borders, watermark, glow, spotlight or noisy speckles. Output the full opaque illustration at 1536x1024.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: an existing hand-painted 3:2 story postcard for the Sichuan countryside game 旅行癞疙宝.
Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Preserve this exact seven-table rural birthday banquet picture and framing. Change ONLY the small toad and its indigo floral satchel on the near-side dirt paddy path.
Primary request: enlarge that same toad by 30% relative to THIS reference (width and height each multiplied by 1.30, not double-sized), and move it with its proportionally scaled bag farther down the same path toward the viewer. It should be an easily noticed foreground observer while remaining across the water ditch from the distant banquet. Keep its original pose and gaze toward the birthday guests.
Placement guide for the unchanged 1536x1024 canvas: the reference toad body is approximately x276–361, y658–749. Target body approximately x475–586, y747–865, about 111px wide and 118px high. Bag sits on dry earth immediately to its left, approximately x409–475, y810–866. Character and bag fully visible on the open dry path, clearly in front of the large corner leaves rather than concealed by them; no part standing in water or touching the image border. Feet and bag have natural contact shadows. Restore the old location as normal dirt path; exactly ONE toad and ONE bag remain.
Identity: preserve the SAME low broad squat olive toad with no neck, amber half-lidded eyes, orange bean-shaped glands, cream belly, short rounded limbs and few larger warts. Preserve the indigo white-flower bag, brass clasp and red chili knot. Same warm hand-painted watercolor/gouache, brown contours and large quiet color planes; no added fine speckles.
STRICT invariants: keep EXACTLY the existing SEVEN distinct round banquet tables (four rear tables and three front tables), all their people, positions and sizes, elderly birthday honoree, servers and longevity peach buns, stools, cooking station, house, lanterns, fields, water ditch, landscape, foliage, lighting, colors and camera unchanged. Preserve the single existing wall character “寿”; add NO new text. Do not move the toad into the banquet or closer to the guests: move it toward the camera along the near-side path. No giant toad, no change to banquet scale, no zoom/crop, no new props, captions, borders, watermark, glow or spotlight. Output the full opaque illustration at 1536x1024.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target, the current seven-table Sichuan birthday illustration. One correction ONLY: the toad in this image was made too large. Reduce the current toad AND blue flower bag together to 70% of their CURRENT width and CURRENT height (multiply both dimensions by 0.70). This is a SHRINK edit, not an enlargement.
Preserve the existing foreground setting. Place the resized group a little farther right on the same clear dry path: the toad body should be approximately 125 pixels wide and 116 pixels tall on the unchanged 1536x1024 canvas, occupying around x441–566, y768–884. The bag sits immediately to its left. Leave all feet, the whole bag and chili charm fully visible on the dirt, without leaf occlusion. Restore surrounding dirt and natural small contact shadows seamlessly. Exactly one toad and one bag; preserve identical character design, squat silhouette, pose, amber eyes, cream belly, olive body, brown outline and expression, white flower bag pattern, brass clasp, chili knot.
Everything else is locked: keep the same seven round tables (four rear, three front), every guest, birthday honoree and peach buns, house and single “寿” sign, fields, water channel, trees, foreground leaves, colors, lighting and hand-painted style unchanged. No changing camera, zooming, cropping, restyling or adding details. Keep the toad an observer on the near side of the ditch. Output full opaque1536x1024. Again: shrink ONLY the current foreground toad and bag by 30%, to 70% of their current linear dimensions.
